name: manual_df4a50
claim: Performance qualification must distinguish the approved workload from smoke tests and historical results. Use refresh-off and single-sender controls, scheduled-time latency, explicit failure accounting and statistical error bounds; a timeout denial is not evidence of fail-open or a reason to weaken authority checks.

decisions.notes: C6 Mac controls at 89da844c isolated refresh interference: no-refresh 800 sends passed while one-sender refresh still failed. Triple verification inside nested write locks was profiled; target budgets remain unmet and a 2400-send zero-error sample cannot prove a 0.1 percent upper bound.
